name: nightshift
description: Route inference to the cheapest machine that can run it, and get a signed receipt back.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:preview: npm run build -w packages/shared && cd apps/web && vite build -c vite.preview.config.ts
